    "uptime": "uptime; echo; free -m; echo; nproc; echo; cat /proc/loadavg",

    "docker_ps": "docker ps --format 'table {{.Names}}\\t{{.Image}}\\t{{.Status}}' 2>&1 | head -60",
    "docker_stats": "docker stats --no-stream --format 'table {{.Name}}\\t{{.CPUPerc}}\\t{{.MemUsage}}\\t{{.MemPerc}}\\t{{.PIDs}}' 2>&1 | sort -t$'\\t' -k1 | head -80",
    "disk": "df -h / /var/lib/docker 2>&1",
}

c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect(HOST, username=USER, password=***, timeout=20, look_for_keys=False, allow_agent=False)
for k, v in cmds.items():
    stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command(v, timeout=90)
    out = stdout.read().decode("utf-8", "ignore")
    err = stderr.read().decode("utf-8", "ignore")

import paramiko

HOST = "192.168.50.188"
USER = "root"
PWD = "***"

cmds = [
    ("docker_stats_full", "docker stats --no-stream --format '{{.Name}}\t{{.CPUPerc}}\t{{.MemUsage}}\t{{.MemPerc}}\t{{.PIDs}}' | sort -t$'\\t' -k2 -hr | head -40"),
    ("top_by_container_cpu", "for c in $(docker ps -q); do n=$(docker inspect --format '{{.Name}}' $c); echo -n \"$c $n \"; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/system.slice/docker-$c.scope/cpu.stat 2>/dev/null | head -1; done | head -50"),
    ("ps_cpu_top20", "ps -eo pid,ppid,user,%cpu,%mem,rss,etime,cmd --sort=-%cpu | head -25"),
    ("zombie_parents", "ps -eo stat,ppid,comm | awk '$1 ~ /Z/ {print $2\" \"$3}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -20"),
    ("free_detail", "free -m; echo ---; cat /proc/loadavg"),
    ("io_top", "which iotop || (cat /proc/pressure/io 2>/dev/null; uptime)"),
]

c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect(HOST, username=USER, password=***, timeout=20)
for name, cmd in cmds:
    print("=" * 20, name, "=" * 20)
    stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command(cmd, timeout=90)
    print(stdout.read().decode("utf-8", "replace"))
    err = stderr.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
    if err.strip():
        print("[stderr]", err[:500])
c.close()

import paramiko

c.connect(HOST, username=USER, password=***, timeout=20)

def run(cmd, t=120):
    si,so,se = c.exec_command(cmd, timeout=t)
    out = so.read().decode(errors="replace"); err = se.read().decode(errors="replace")
    return out + (("\nERR " + err) if err.strip() else "")

def sec(t, cmd, tm=120):

    print(run(cmd, tm).strip()[:6000])

sec("zombie_state_count", "grep -c '^State:\\s*Z' /proc/[0-9]*/status 2>/dev/null | tail -1; ps -eo stat= | grep -c '^Z'")

sec("zombie_ppid_names", "for p in $(ps -eo stat=,ppid= | awk '$1 ~ /^Z/ {c[$2]++} END {for (p in c) print c[p], p}' | sort -rn | head -8 | awk '{print $2}'); do echo \"-- ppid $p: $(tr '\\0' ' ' < /proc/$p/cmdline | cut -c1-160)\"; done")

cd ~/workspace && cat > ssh_docker_final.py <<'PYEOF'
import paramiko, time
HOST="192.168.50.188"; USER="root"; PWD="***"
c=paramiko.SSHClient(); c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect(HOST, username=USER, password=***, timeout=20)
def run(cmd, t=60):
    ch=c.get_transport().open_session(); ch.settimeout(t); ch.exec_command(cmd)
    out=b""
    while True:
        if ch.recv_ready():
            out+=ch.recv(65536)
        elif ch.exit_status_ready():
            try:
                while ch.recv_ready(): out+=ch.recv(65536)
            except: pass
            break
        else:
            time.sleep(0.05)
    return out.decode("utf-8","replace")

print("== 僵尸进程增长观察（每 5 秒一次，共 3 次）==")
for i in range(3):
    n=run("ps -eo stat | grep -c '^Z'")
    l=run("cat /proc/loadavg")
    print(f"第{i+1}次: 僵尸={n.strip()}  load={l.strip()}")
    if i<2: time.sleep(5)

print("\n== 内存 TOP 容器（docker stats 内存倒序，含上限）==")
print(run("docker stats --no-stream --format '{{.Name}}\\t{{.CPUPerc}}\\t{{.MemUsage}}\\t{{.MemPerc}}\\t{{.PIDs}}' | sort -t$'\\t' -k3 -hr | head -15"))

print("\n== 各容器内存总量与主机内存 ==")
print(run("free -m; echo ---; cat /proc/meminfo | egrep 'MemTotal|MemAvailable|SwapTotal|SwapFree'; echo ---; echo 'cgroup 内存占用前 8:'; "
          "for d in /sys/fs/cgroup/system.slice/docker-*.scope; do m=$(cat $d/memory.current 2>/dev/null); echo \"$m $d\"; done | sort -nr | head -8"))

print("\n== 是否 OOM / 内核报错 ==")
print(run("journalctl -k --since '1 day ago' 2>/dev/null | egrep -i 'oom|out of memory|fork' | tail -10; echo ---; cat /proc/meminfo | grep -i commit"))

print("\n== 僵尸进程占用情况（内存是否真的被占）==")
print(run("ps -eo stat,rss | awk '$1 ~ /^Z/ {s+=$2; n++} END {print \"僵尸数=\" n, \"僵尸RSS合计(KB)=\" s}'"))
print("\n== 各容器僵尸数排名 ==")
print(run("for p in $(ps -eo pid=,stat= | awk '$2 ~ /^Z/ {print $1}'); do pp=$(awk '/^PPid:/{print $2}' /proc/$p/status 2>/dev/null); echo $pp; done | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | head -6"))
print("\n== dmesg 尾部 ==")
print(run("dmesg 2>/dev/null | tail -15"))
print("\n== 磁盘 ==")
print(run("df -h / /var/lib/docker 2>&1 | head -5; echo ---; docker system df"))
c.close()

import paramiko, time

c=paramiko.SSHClient(); c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect(HOST, username=USER, password=***, timeout=20, banner_timeout=30)

def run(cmd, t=60):
    tr=c.get_transport(); ch=tr.open_session(); ch.settimeout(t); ch.exec_command(cmd)

    try:
        while True:
            d=ch.recv(65536)
            if not d: break
            out+=d
    except Exception as e:
        out+=("\n[TIMEOUT]").encode()
    return out.decode("utf-8","replace")
